checks.detail: Analytic product gives (5e,e); symmetric finite differences agree within 1e-7.

checks.detail: Four-cycle top mode has λ=4; η=2/5 contracts by −3/5 whereas η=3/5 amplifies by −7/5. Mass is unchanged.

checks.name: Certified mantissa bracket
checks.detail: Exact rational squares bracket √5 between 2.2360679774997896964 and 2.2360679774997896965; exponent is exactly 27002.

checks.name: Noiseless power-family identification
checks.detail: Inputs 1,2 identify a=3,b=2; the unused third input x=4 predicts 48 exactly.

checks.name: Signed dyadic decomposition
checks.detail: diag(−2,0,3) is the sum of two signed rank-one dyads and has a negative quadratic direction, excluding positive-dyad decomposition.

checks.name: Directional cancellation illustration
checks.detail: All 225 tangent differences vanish; 15 of 240 horizontal differences are nonzero. This checks only the declared finite directional illustration, not a full transform benchmark.

checks.name: Normalized qubit kernel reconstruction
checks.detail: The six-axis spherical quadrature reconstructs a nontrivial Hermitian density matrix to <1e-14 and checks normalization and a trace pairing.

checks.name: Exact polynomial Moyal algebra
checks.detail: Gaussian rational arithmetic checks q⋆p−p⋆q=i, the full q²⋆p² formula, and all 216 associativity triples from monomials of total degree ≤2. ℏ=1.

checks.name: Fractional periodic spectral evolution
checks.detail: Three-mode spectral norm and a 16-point physical-space Parseval sum remain one to <1e-14 for α=3/2.

checks.name: Lagrange identity
checks.detail: Vectors (1,2,3),(2,−1,4) give Cauchy–Schwarz deficit 150 and squared minors 25+4+121=150.

checks.name: Winding and sphere calibration
checks.detail: The analytic derivative ratio for e^(3it) integrates to winding three; curvature×area for radius-two sphere is 4π.

checks.name: Marked torus stretch
checks.detail: The affine b=2 stretch gives exact Beltrami coefficient −1/3 and dilatation 2; its lattice periods are 1 and 2i.

checks.name: Certified logistic thresholds
checks.detail: Exact rational squaring brackets r₂=1+√6 to width 1e−15. Exact rational multipliers at r=3.2 and 3.5 check opposite sides of stability. A two-cycle is checked independently; a numerical derivative/Schwarzian cross-check verifies the flip cubic formula, whose strict positivity is proved analytically in the text.

checks.name: State-versus-parameter examples
checks.detail: Exact quadratic critical orbits distinguish c=0,−1,1. Lorenz divergence at σ=10,β=8/3 is −41/3; this is not a chaos certificate.

checks.name: Convex conjugate and boundary optimizer
checks.detail: For k=2,p=−4 the full-line optimizer is −1 with value 2; the constrained half-line optimizer is 0 with value 0. Fenchel inequalities are checked on rational examples.

checks.name: CHSH deterministic exhaustion
checks.detail: All sixteen deterministic assignments give S=±2. The declared iid 1000-trial 0.80 win-fraction Hoeffding bound is e^(−5).

checks.name: Syzygy and strict-transform checks
checks.detail: Exact polynomial arithmetic verifies both syzygies and generated relations for (x²,xy,y²). The cusp strict transform is v²−x, with derivative −1 in x; its further normal-crossings issue is retained in the text.

checks.name: Toric lattice certificate
checks.detail: The original determinant is 2; both subdivided cone determinants are 1. Dual Hilbert-generator relation gives uw=v².

checks.name: Hodge consistency examples
checks.detail: Künneth multiplication gives Hodge polynomial (1+uv)² for P¹×P¹. The plane-quintic genus is six and curve Euler characteristic −10.

checks.name: Conic parametrization and obstruction
checks.detail: Rational circle parametrizations are checked exactly. Exhaustion modulo three shows a²+b²≡0 forces a≡b≡0, the key step in the primitive descent excluding x²+y²=3 over Q.

checks.name: Typed composition and Hermitian positivity
checks.detail: The valid derivative product is [2,3,23]. For z=(1,i), zᵀz=0 but z†z=2.

method: Portable Python standard library; exact rational and polynomial checks where stated, numerical tolerance checks explicitly labeled.
